verdicts.reason: A falls apart: the logo sits half outside the dark header so the SOLSTICE wordmark is lost, the eyebrow now sits below its own headline and body copy, the headline is shrunk small, the divider and legal text float mid-canvas, and a tiny CTA is stranded at the bottom with huge dead gaps. B keeps the original order and hierarchy (logo, eyebrow, big headline, body, divider, CTA, ships note, legal), but it leaves an awkward empty band between the headline and body copy, the divider now sits below the body instead of under the headline, the eyebrow is smaller, and the 'Evenings' orphan is still there.
